title: Co-Designing AI for Clinical Work
summary: Designing a multi-mode clinical AI system and behavioral telemetry pipeline to support therapist decision-making.
context: Clinicians delivering exposure therapy face high cognitive load when structuring case hierarchies, tracking patient progress, and adapting interventions, while standard LLM interfaces lack clinical guardrails and human gatekeeping controls.
bullets: Co-designed and architected a multi-mode AI clinical workbench with 32 therapists, integrating RAG over clinical literature, persistent workspaces, and clinician oversight controls.
Engineered an AWS SQL telemetry pipeline to process 3,000+ user interaction logs across planning, reflection, and material-generation workflows.
Modeled behavioral log data using regression and ANOVA to isolate 8 adoption drivers, reducing clinician mental workload by 27% during case conceptualization.

title: Predictive Workflow & Readiness Modeling
summary: Modeling workflow telemetry and compliance readiness frameworks across multi-sector national security R&D.
context: At LAS—a cross-sector research lab bridging government, industry, and academia—complex analytic studies frequently stalled between conception and execution due to opaque regulatory, data-security, and compliance dependencies.
bullets: Conducted contextual inquiries with intelligence analysts, product owners, and compliance officers to map end-to-end study lifecycles and failure modes.
Applied random forest feature ranking to operational workflow telemetry to pinpoint the drivers of multi-week R&D delays.
Developed a multi-dimensional Project Maturity Framework and 5 workflow estimation tools, reducing compliance review errors by 12% and improving task speed by 14%.

title: Enterprise Telemetry & AI Assistant
summary: Combining enterprise SQL behavioral analytics with AI decision-support scoping across 3.5M+ users and 80+ Fortune 500 clients.
context: WTW's enterprise benefits and Retiree Self-Service platforms support 3.5M+ users annually across 80+ Fortune 500 clients, where complex healthcare and pension elections created decision bottlenecks and product teams relied on manual SQL requests to diagnose drop-offs.
bullets: Queried large-scale navigation paths and session logs from the enterprise data warehouse and built automated SQL-to-Power BI pipelines, cutting ad-hoc SQL requests by 60%.
Scoped an MVP AI enrollment assistant and defined safe decision-support boundaries through user interviews, reducing benefit election decision time by 30%.
Executed iterative A/B testing and journey mapping across 5 agile sprints, lifting end-to-end task completion by 22%.

title: Multi-User 3D Spatial Systems
summary: Developing networked multi-user 3D prototypes and conducting empirical spatial interaction pilots.
context: Multi-user virtual reality environments often suffer from spatial disorientation and interaction friction when translating complex 3D architectural and computational models into collaborative scenes.
bullets: Engineered and shipped 3 networked, multi-user 3D interactive prototypes using computational design and real-time rendering pipelines.
Designed and conducted empirical VR usability pilots with 18 participants to evaluate locomotion mechanics, spatial navigation, and task completion.
Trained 10+ researchers and developers on VR interaction workflows and delivered 3 production-ready showcases for university stakeholders.
